posts.body:
This is Lacey's husband, Mark.  She is at the hospital with her sister as her water has PARTIALLY broken. 🤔   So they are keeping her there because fluid is being lost in small amounts.  But until it gets to a certain level then Kaydon can remain in his Auntie's tummy. 🙂   Another thing they are watching for is Chrissy having elevated blood pressure and so they are keeping an eye on it.  She is already 4cm along too. 😲   So we just wait wait wait as they just monitor Kaydon. 🤔   I am not at the hospital because Kelsey is sick with a double ear infection high temp 😲  🤒  😭  and needs either Mommy or Daddy. 😍
Will keep you updated on things about Kaydon. 😀

Fingers crossed for you and poor Kelsey she ha shad a right itme of things resently. Hope the ear infection isn't affecting her asthma. Safe arrival of Kaydon and blood pressure come down vibes coming your way by the truck full. can't wait to hear about Kaydon and how things are going with you all when Kaydon comes home.

Hello and thanks.  They are keeping Chrissy because Kaydon;s fluid level is low but is not dropping lower as of right now.  And her BP is still up but moderately.  Its a waiting game.  They wany Kaydon to "brew" as long as possible... so let's hope thing just remain boring and uneventful until he wants to make his grande appearance.  Kel is still the same.  I am taking her back in to the pediatricion tomorrow morning ASAP.

Sending stay put vibes to your Sis, hope Kelsey feels better soon too  😘 - 35+ weeks is fabulous anyway  👶
Big hugs and lots of love to you all xxx

hope all is okay
Big hugs to you all  😘  😘

Kelsey needs to have tubes put in her ears... because they keep getting filled and infected and do not drain properly.  We do not want her under any kind of surgery, but she needs this.  So we all decided it best ASAP... and so Thursday morning she goes in.  Of course my wife is terrified because it means she will be under some amount of anesthetic and she is still a baby yet... but The Dr assured us this is done often and safe.  Better to do it now.  It is getting worse.  It is just not a convenient time since Kaydon could arrive any day.   😲   So its a little tense here but getting Kel thru thursday and keeping her comfy after things will be alright.  We are hoping Kaydon stays put until things with Kel settle down.  Chrissy is doing well... just feeling antsy in the hospital.
Thanks for the thoughts.   🙂
Aah, poor Kelsey- hope she feels a lot better after op.  😘  😘  😘  😘  😘
Just posted on the other thread about Kaydon arriving but wanted to add more hugs and wishers. Hope Kelsey gets better soon and ocngartes once again
